잘 먹었습니다.forms: polite: 잘 먹었어요 · casual: 잘 먹었어
잘 먹었습니다.m: thank you for the meal (said after eating)
잘 먹었습니다.x: Grandma, thank you — that was really delicious.
잘 먹었습니다.e: Literally 'I ate well' — the past-tense partner of 잘 먹겠습니다, said after the meal.
잘 먹었습니다.t: Said after eating to the host or the person who paid — also to restaurant staff when leaving.

지하철.x: The subway is very convenient in Seoul.
지하철.e: Literally 'underground iron (rail)'. 지하 alone means basement or underground.

약속.x: I have plans with a friend this evening.
약속.t: 약속 covers both 'promise' and 'plans to meet someone'. Pronounced [약쏙].

아니다.e: Negative of 이다: 학생이 아니에요 = I'm not a student. 아니요 = no.
아니다.t: The noun takes 이/가: 학생이 아니에요. 아니에요 alone also means 'Not at all / You're welcome.'

행복하다.x: I'm happy when I'm with my family.
행복하다.t: Pronounced [행보카다]. 행복하세요! = 'Be happy!' — a common warm wish.

많이.forms: 많이 + verb: 많이 먹어요 · 많이 드세요 (eat a lot — said to guests)
많이.e: From 많다 (to be many). 많이 드세요 = 'Eat a lot!' — a host's warm urging.

땀이 나다.forms: 땀이 나요 · 땀이 났어요; 땀이 많이 나다 (to sweat a lot)
땀이 나다.ex: 날씨가 너무 더워서 가만히 있어도 땀이 나요.
땀이 나다.x: It's so hot that I sweat even sitting still.
땀이 나다.e: Literally 'sweat comes out'; 나다 works the same way in 열이 나다 and 화가 나다.

짐을 싸다.forms: 짐을 싸요 · 짐을 쌌어요; opposite: 짐을 풀다
짐을 싸다.ex: 내일 아침 일찍 떠나서 오늘 밤에 짐을 싸야 해요.
짐을 싸다.x: I'm leaving early tomorrow morning, so I have to pack tonight.
짐을 싸다.t: Also figurative for quitting or moving out: 짐을 싸서 나갔어요 'packed up and left.'

책장.ex: 제 방 책장에는 만화책이 가득 있어요.
책장.x: The bookshelf in my room is full of comic books.
책장.e: Literally 'book cabinet'. Homonym: another 책장 means 'page of a book'.

방송.m: broadcast, broadcasting; TV or radio program; announcement
방송.ex: 이 프로그램은 매주 토요일 저녁에 방송돼요.
방송.x: This program airs every Saturday evening.
방송.t: Also used for announcements: 안내 방송 in the subway or a store.

밀가루.ex: 빵이나 국수를 만들 때 밀가루가 필요해요.
밀가루.x: You need flour when you make bread or noodles.

섞다.x: Please mix the flour and sugar well.

찾아오다.m: to come to see, to come visit
찾아오다.x: A friend came to visit my house on the weekend.
찾아오다.e: 찾다 'to look for' plus 오다 'come': come to find someone.

기르다.forms: 길러요 · 길렀어요 · 기를 거예요 · 기르세요 (르 irregular)
기르다.m: to raise, to bring up; to keep (a pet), to grow (plants); to grow (hair)
기르다.ex: 우리 가족은 강아지 한 마리를 길러요.
기르다.e: Also for hair or beards: 머리를 기르다 = to grow your hair out.

따르다.forms: 따라요 · 따랐어요 · 따를 거예요 · 따르세요 (ㅡ drops)
따르다.m: to follow, to obey; to pour
따르다.x: We did the experiment following the teacher's explanation.
따르다.e: Two meanings share one spelling: 물을 따르다 means 'to pour water'.
따르다.t: -에 따라 means 'according to': 날씨에 따라 = depending on the weather.

에게서.forms: Same form after any person or animal; more formal or written than 한테서
에게서.ex: 저는 이 편지를 고향 친구에게서 받았어요.
에게서.x: I got this letter from a friend back home.

신.ex: 옛날 사람들은 산에 신이 산다고 믿었어요.
신.x: People long ago believed that gods lived in the mountains.
신.e: Homonym warning: a native 신 means 'shoes', now usually 신발.
신.t: For the Christian God, Protestants say 하나님 and Catholics say 하느님.

상황.ex: 지금 상황이 좋지 않아서 여행을 미뤘어요.
상황.x: The situation isn't good right now, so I postponed the trip.

복습.ex: 집에 가서 오늘 배운 단어를 복습하세요.
복습.x: Go home and review the words you learned today.

화나다.m: to get angry, to be mad
화나다.x: I got mad because my brother broke my stuff.
화나다.e: Literally 'fire comes out': anger pictured as rising fire.
화나다.t: 화나다 is feeling angry; 화를 내다 (화내다) is expressing anger at someone.

공통.ex: 두 사람은 음악이라는 공통 관심사가 있어요.
공통.x: The two of them share an interest in music.

중소기업.ex: 저는 직원이 오십 명인 중소기업에 다녀요.
중소기업.x: I work at a small company with fifty employees.

복통.ex: 어제 저녁을 먹고 나서 심한 복통이 생겼어요.
복통.x: After dinner yesterday, I got a bad stomachache.
복통.e: Literally 'belly pain'. -통 = pain: 두통, 치통, 복통.
복통.t: 복통 is medical; in daily conversation say 배가 아파요.

명랑하다.x: Our daughter is cheerful, so she has lots of friends.
명랑하다.t: Pronounced [명낭하다]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

감추다.x: He couldn't hide his disappointed look.

담그다.forms: 담가요 · 담갔어요 · 담글 거예요 · 담그세요 (ㅡ drops)
담그다.m: to make (kimchi, pickles), to pickle; to soak, to dip
담그다.x: Grandma makes kimjang kimchi every year.
담그다.e: Basic idea: putting something into liquid — soaking, or brining kimchi.
담그다.t: Standard forms are 담가요 and 담갔어요; 담궈요 is a very common mistake, even among natives.

음주 운전.ex: 음주 운전은 다른 사람의 생명도 위험하게 해요.
음주 운전.x: Drunk driving puts other people's lives in danger too.

관심사.ex: 요즘 젊은 사람들의 가장 큰 관심사는 취업이에요.
관심사.x: These days the biggest concern for young people is getting a job.

질리다.m: to be fed up with, to be sick of; to be appalled
질리다.ex: 이 노래는 아무리 들어도 질리지 않아요.
질리다.x: No matter how much I listen to this song, I never get tired of it.

도무지.ex: 이 문제는 도무지 이해할 수가 없어요.
도무지.x: I can't understand this problem at all.
도무지.t: Used with negatives and frustration: 도무지 모르겠어요 'I have no idea at all.'

막상.m: when it actually comes to it, actually (in reality)
막상.ex: 막상 시험을 보려고 하니 너무 떨렸어요.
막상.x: When it actually came time to take the test, I was so nervous.
막상.t: Contrasts expectation with reality: 막상 해 보니 쉬웠어요 'once I actually tried, it was easy'.
rel: when it comes down to it

더불어.x: A life lived together with your neighbors is important.
더불어.e: From 더불다 'to be together with', now used only in this form.

들뜨다.forms: 들떠요 · 들떴어요 · 들뜰 거예요 · 들뜬 (+noun) (ㅡ drops)
들뜨다.m: to be excited, to be restless; (of wallpaper, skin) to lift, to peel
들뜨다.x: I'm all excited with the trip coming up.
들뜨다.e: Contains 뜨다 'to float': your heart floats up with excitement.

기를 쓰다.forms: 기를 써요 · 기를 썼어요 · 기를 쓰고 + verb (ㅡ drops)
기를 쓰다.m: to try with all one's might, to go all out
기를 쓰다.x: He tried with all his might to come in first.

줄임말.ex: 요즘 줄임말이 너무 많아서 무슨 뜻인지 모르겠어요.
줄임말.x: There are so many abbreviations these days that I don't know what they mean.
줄임말.t: Korean often keeps the first syllable of each part: 프로필 사진 → 프사, 단체 톡방 → 단톡방.

진화론.ex: 다윈의 진화론은 생물학에 큰 영향을 주었습니다.
진화론.x: Darwin's theory of evolution had a great influence on biology.

범하다.m: to commit (a crime, an error); to violate
범하다.ex: 누구나 실수를 범할 수 있으니 너무 걱정하지 마세요.
범하다.x: Anyone can make a mistake, so don't worry too much.
범하다.e: One syllable meaning 'violate' — crossing a line you shouldn't.
범하다.t: Formal, with objects like 실수, 잘못, 죄, 오류; in casual speech, 실수하다 sounds more natural.

협조적.x: The residents were cooperative, so construction finished quickly.

불가피하게.x: The event was unavoidably canceled because of the typhoon.

괜스레.ex: 비 오는 날에는 괜스레 기분이 우울해져요.
괜스레.x: On rainy days, I feel gloomy for no particular reason.
괜스레.e: A softer, more literary form of 괜히 'for no reason', from 괜하다.

갑론을박.m: heated back-and-forth debate; arguing pro and con
갑론을박.ex: 그 문제를 두고 회의에서 갑론을박이 벌어졌어요.
갑론을박.x: A heated back-and-forth broke out at the meeting over that issue.
갑론을박.t: Pronounced [감노늘박] — nasalization; often 갑론을박이 벌어지다 or 이어지다.

가닥을 잡다.forms: 가닥을 잡아요 · 가닥을 잡았어요 · 가닥이 잡히다
가닥을 잡다.m: to get a handle on; to settle on a direction
가닥을 잡다.ex: 회의 끝에 프로젝트 방향의 가닥을 잡았어요.
가닥을 잡다.x: At the end of the meeting, we settled on a direction for the project.
가닥을 잡다.e: 가닥 = a strand; you pick out the right strand from a tangle.

기계화.x: Mechanization of farming has greatly reduced the need for labor.

칼군무.x: That group is famous for its members' perfectly synchronized dancing.
칼군무.e: 칼 'knife' + 군무 'group dance': a dance as sharp and precise as a knife cut.
칼군무.t: Praise for K-pop groups whose members move in exact unison. 칼 means 'precise, exact' in other words too, like 칼퇴근 'leaving work right on time'.

구치소.x: The suspect was held in a detention center while awaiting trial.
구치소.e: Literally 'place where people are held in custody'.
구치소.t: 구치소 holds people before or during trial; after sentencing they go to 교도소 (prison).

사이버보안.x: The government decided to strengthen cybersecurity.

정녕.x: Is this truly our last chance?
정녕.e: Used in heartfelt questions and vows: 'is it really so?'
정녕.t: Dramatic and literary; common in historical dramas and song lyrics.

생태학.ex: 그녀는 대학원에서 해양 생태학을 전공하고 있어요.
생태학.x: She is majoring in marine ecology in graduate school.

화산재.ex: 화산재 때문에 공항의 모든 비행기가 결항됐어요.
화산재.x: All flights at the airport were canceled because of volcanic ash.
화산재.t: Pronounced [화산째]: 재 becomes tense in this compound.
